steps.input:
{
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    a=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h=len(a); w=len(a[0])
    # Objects are shifted along diagonal, each block arranged to touch neighboring shapes.
    # inferred layers: first vertical object stays at left; others move up/left by one row/column
    pts={c:[(r,j) for r in range(h) for j in range(w) if a[r][j]==c] for c in set(sum(a,[])) if c}
    # preserve initial objects while clear
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    cols=sorted(pts, key=lambda c:min(j for r,j in pts[c]))
    # shift each successive object diagonally up-left, beginning first at original
    for k,c in enumerate(cols):
        rr=[r for r,j in pts[c]]; cc=[j for r,j in pts[c]]
        dr=min(rr); dc=min(cc)
        # translation according to ordinal: each later object shifted up by 1 and left by 1 vs input
        nr=dr-k; nc=dc-k
        for r,j in pts[c]:
            y=r-k; x=j-k
            if 0<=y<h and 0<=x<w: out[y][x]=c
    return out
"
}
